q: Which of the following statements is true of the isotopes of an element?
opts: They have the same mass number
They have the same number of neutrons
They have the same atomic number
explanation: Isotopes are atoms of the same element with the same atomic number (number of protons) but different mass numbers due to different numbers of neutrons.

q: The vertical columns in the periodic table are called _____.
explanation: The periodic table is arranged in vertical columns called groups and horizontal rows called periods.

q: Which of the following elements has the highest electronegativity?
explanation: Fluorine is the most electronegative element in the periodic table because it has the strongest tendency to attract a shared pair of electrons.

q: The type of bond formed when two atoms share a pair of electrons, with both electrons coming from one of the atoms, is _____.
explanation: A dative (or coordinate) covalent bond occurs when the shared pair of electrons is provided by only one of the participating atoms.
